d:
Kalyan Bigha, Nalanda | In this Ground Report, Khabargaon travelled to CM Nitish Kumar's ancestral village in Nalanda District. We spoke to the young voters who are preparing for competitive exams. We spoke about unemployment, migration, poverty and other issues that concern the youth of the state.
While the young voters appreciate Nitish Kumar's policies related to fundamental needs, they also questioned his policies related to unemployment and migration.
Moreover, we spoke about why the craze of Governement Jobs persist at such a mass level in Bihar.
Reporter: Satyam
Camera: Abhishek, Aakash
